# Medicinrådet

Medicinrådet is an independent Danish medical council that has issued treatment recommendations relevant to [[danibd|DANIBD]]'s indicator framework for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The organization was formerly known as Rådet for Anvendelsen af Dyr Sygehusmedicin (RADS — the Council for the Use of Hospital Medicine in Animals), a name that appears to reflect an earlier administrative structure or translation context.[^src1][^src2]

The council's recommendations are cited as a key reference point in [[danibd|DANIBD]]'s quality measurement standards for IBD treatment across Danish hospitals. Medicinrådet is explicitly identified as independent, distinguishing it from other professional bodies such as [[dansk-selskab-for-gastroenterologi|Dansk Selskab for Gastroenterologi]] (Danish Society for Gastroenterology) with which it is referenced alongside in [[danibd|DANIBD]]'s documentation.[^src1][^src2]

## Mentions

- **Page 18**, *DANIBD_2023.pdf*: "jf. anbefalinger fra Dansk Selskab for Gastroenterologi og det uafhængige Medicinrådet (tidligere Rådet for Anvendelsen af Dyr Sygehusmedicin, RADS)."[^src1]

- **Page 31**, *DANIBD_2024.pdf*: "det uafhængige Medicinrådet (tidligere Rådet for Anvendelsen af Dyr Sygehusmedicin, RADS)"[^src2]

## Relationships

- Referenced alongside [[dansk-selskab-for-gastroenterologi|Dansk Selskab for Gastroenterologi]] as a source of treatment recommendations for [[danibd|DANIBD]]'s indicator framework.[^src1]

## Claims

- Medicinrådet is independent (uafhængige).[^src1][^src2]
- Medicinrådet was formerly named Rådet for Anvendelsen af Dyr Sygehusmedicin (RADS).[^src1][^src2]
- Medicinrådet has issued recommendations for IBD treatment relevant to [[danibd|DANIBD]]'s indicator set.[^src1]
